summary: BackendSpec — database-flavored subclass of mountainash_settings.profiles.ProfileSpec. Adds default_port, connection_string_scheme, ibis_dialect, and rides_on fields. Used as the __spec__ class variable on every per-backend settings class. Includes deprecated BackendDescriptor alias with DeprecationWarning.
extension_points: BackendSpec is the spec type for new database backends — subclass or instantiate directly
lifecycle_notes: BackendDescriptor renamed to BackendSpec in this refactor — module __getattr__ provides deprecation bridge.
rides_on metadata field: motherduck uses duckdb's ibis path; this is metadata only, not enforced at runtime.
documentation_hooks: ibis_dialect field wires the settings class to IbisBackend._init_from_settings() — critical for settings-driven construction
connection_string_scheme is used by both ConnectionProfile.to_connection_string() and IbisBackend._build_scheme_to_dialect()
